notes: Spent most turns clicking for credits while sitting on 12-15 credits with no breakers installed, and ran into the already-seen unbreakable Piranhas twice for nothing. Never contested the remotes the Corp scored from.
Simple, sound play: iced centrals, scored agendas from an iced remote, and kept credits healthy. One turn of three click-for-credit actions while rich was minor waste.

Ran an empty R&D four times a turn, which mostly re-accessed the same top card, and left three cards uninstalled at 3 credits for the whole game. Got flatlined by Measured Response while holding a small grip against Weyland.
Scored steadily from a Hagen-protected remote and used campaigns and Hedge Fund well. R&D stayed thin behind a single Vertigo for a long time, and there were a few idle credit clicks.
Good aggressive multi-access pressure on R&D and HQ that won quickly. Ending a turn with three tags against a rich Corp was risky but went unpunished.

Installed and rezzed Otto Campaign in a naked remote where it was trashed at once, then rezzed an expensive Eli and spent several turns broke. R&D stayed behind a single Tithe while the Runner stole repeatedly.
Built an economy and repeatedly hit HQ through Funhouse to steal several agendas, then finished on R&D with a breaker. Spent some clicks and credits removing tags that kept coming back.

Clicked for credits nearly every click for 19 turns, reaching 69 credits while never installing anything. Repeatedly let the Corp advance and score from a remote it had already run through successfully.
Economy cratered after the early rezzes, leaving the Corp clicking for credits and discarding for many turns. It installed Lotus Haze behind a single ice, where it was stolen.

Early fast advances worked, but Longevity Serum was used to dump most of HQ. Lotus Haze went behind one ice against a Runner with 37 credits and was stolen, and there were several idle credit clicks while rich.
Scored efficiently overall, but put Next Big Thing behind a lone, known Ping and left it there to be stolen. It then reused the same weak server for the winning agenda.

Eventually won through an R&D lock, but sat on 20+ credits for long stretches with no working breakers. It ran a freshly installed Banner into a known Ballista and burned many clicks on the Trickster Taka tag cycle.

Spent four straight turns at 1 credit trying to trash Daily Casts while agendas piled up in a lightly iced HQ and were stolen. Finished by installing an unadvanced agenda in a remote the Runner had already broken.
Jacked out twice after already passing the only ice in front of an agenda, which the Corp then scored. Later ran into known Karuna on a one-card grip and flatlined itself.
Reasonable R&D pressure with Revolver, but it ignored a remote agenda that sat for five turns while the Corp was broke and was then scored. It never contested the final scoring server.
Built a four-ice remote it never used and spent many turns clicking for credits while R&D stayed behind a single Vertigo that leaked three agendas. It recovered by scoring from a second remote.
Found a Banner line through HQ's Akhet early and pressed it hard for a fast win. It took Measured Response damage but managed it fine.
Spent all its money on three remote ice for a server holding only a trap, then clicked for credits for turns. Its agendas stayed in HQ behind one Ivik until they were stolen.
Good use of Drafter and Ansel, campaign economy, and timely fast-advances. A duplicate Wage Workers rez wasted credits.

Had a strong early R&D run up to 6 points but drained to 0 credits taking a tag on every run. It then spent ten turns removing tags and clicking for single credits while the Corp built a huge bank and scored out.
